solico.label: About the group
solico.title: Solico Group
solico.lead: A multinational food company that started with one workshop in 1971.
solico.storyTitle: From raw materials to the shop shelf
paragraphs: Solico Group produces, distributes and sells food in more than 10 countries: dairy, ice cream, ready meals, beverages and snacks, for retail and food service. It is one of the largest food processing operations in the Middle East.

The group runs its own supply chain: raw materials (milk is the largest), transport, production and direct distribution to shops. Its global headquarters is in Dubai, UAE, with regional offices in Tehran, Erbil, Baghdad, Frankfurt, Los Angeles, Izmir and Kabul.
Sofood Kaz is the group's production company in Kazakhstan.

founder.label: Founder
founder.name: Gholamali Soleimani
paragraphs: Gholamali Soleimani was born in 1946 in Amol, Iran.
He started with a small hamburger workshop. He then built up the meat and dairy businesses, followed by many other food categories.
Today the group he founded works in more than 10 countries.

factory.label: The factory
factory.title: The dairy complex in Konaev
factory.lead: The cheese plant is phase one. Three more production sites and a packaging area follow.
paragraphs: Phase one is a cheese plant with a capacity of 40,920 tonnes of products a year. It will make cream, hard and brined cheeses, ultrafiltered cheese, cream cheese, labneh and mozzarella.
The full complex is phase one plus three more production sites and a packaging area of about 4 hectares. Central and technical warehouses and the utilities sit on the same site.

The project runs under an investment agreement with the Ministry of Agriculture of the Republic of Kazakhstan. On 22 October 2026 the plans were presented to the Prime Minister at the Kazakhstan Global Investment Roundtable (KGIR-2026).
